settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Choose the language, how simply text is written, and how it looks.
settings.levelHelp: Lower numbers use shorter words and shorter sentences.
settings.dyslexiaHelp: Wider letter and word spacing and a more open typeface. This is not a dyslexia-specific font.
settings.previewText: You must tell the landlord in writing at least 60 days before the lease ends.

help.title: Help
help.intro: How the Plain Language Layer works, in four steps.

add.title: Add a document
add.text: Choose “Upload / New document”, paste the text or load a .txt file, and give it a title.

read.title: Read the plain version
read.text: Open the document to see the plain-language version next to the original.

check.title: Check what is uncertain
check.text: Sentences the tool is unsure about are marked and say what is unclear. Ask a professional about those.

save.title: Save words you want to remember
save.text: Use the Glossary to look up a hard word and keep it in your own list.

binding.q: Is the plain version legally binding?
binding.a: No. It only explains the original. The original text is the one that counts, so ask a professional before making legal decisions.

accuracy.q: How do I know a sentence was rewritten correctly?
accuracy.a: Each sentence shows a status and a confidence score. Uncertain sentences say what is unclear in the original.

files.a: You can paste text or load a plain .txt file. PDF and Word files are not supported yet.

privacy.a: In the database of the computer or server running this app. The only thing sent to the dictionary service is the single word you look up.
